verdict.rationale: 1Password documents official SDKs in Go, JavaScript, and Python. The docs cover loading secrets via secret references and programmatic item management, and an official GitHub repo (onepassword-sdk-js) corroborates the SDK. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs, and depth on per-language coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: 1Password SDKs allow you to build integrations that programmatically interact with 1Password using Go, JavaScript, or Python.
Automate item management: Programmatically manage items in your 1Password account.
Build integrations that programmatically interact with 1Password.
